title: LINEST and LOGEST are named in an open row; neither has a measurement
upstream_status_verbatim: The ONLY open stage is the LINEST **coefficient** kernel
status_plain: The G3-03 catalogue row is titled for TREND, LINEST and LOGEST, and its open stage is described as the LINEST coefficient kernel with a deterministic 2-ULP-low slope bias. But every measured row in that lane is a TREND row. There is no LINEST batch or answers file in smart-fuzzer/work/w109/ (the G3-03 files are forecast, fc-adv, slope, intercept and trend only), no LINEST row in the recon CSV, and the lane survey lists multivariate LINEST witnesses under machinery still needed - the only regime that separates QR from normal equations is entirely unprobed. The 2-ULP-low slope bias is derived by backing a slope out of TREND's result bits, so it is a TREND measurement used to reason about LINEST's kernel. LOGEST is worse off still: the survey states that no GROWTH/LOGEST live witness corpus exists today. The one Excel comparison either surface has is structural and uncounted: LINEST(...,FALSE) returns a trailing intercept cell of 0 rather than a shortened row, LOGEST(...,FALSE) a trailing base cell of 1, and both return multivariate coefficients in reverse predictor order.
open_question: No LINEST or LOGEST live witness corpus exists. Multivariate witnesses with two to three predictors and const TRUE/FALSE are named as needed machinery; for GROWTH and LOGEST the survey says the corpus does not exist at all.
reader_warning: Being named in an open divergence row is not the same as having been measured. Nothing in this record scores LINEST or LOGEST against Excel, and the "2-ULP-low slope bias" was read off TREND.
